To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting access to the complete, non-redacted investigative records associated with Office of Inspector General Case No. 21-04202.

Specifically, I request:

1. The unredacted investigative report and binder, particularly PDF pages 50–55, including complainant statements, officer statements, witness interviews, and supporting documentation, to the extent not legally exempt.
2. All records identifying the final findings and conclusions of the investigation.
3. The specific statutory authority supporting each redaction in the previously provided records, together with a written, particularized explanation for each exemption pursuant to Florida Statute §119.07(1)(f).
4. The official investigation closure date and any records documenting notification of its conclusion.
5. All final disciplinary dispositions involving Marisol Diaz-Jaquez and Michael Watson, including any suspensions, reprimands, dismissals, disciplinary memoranda, final agency actions, and appeal decisions, to the extent publicly accessible.
6. Any nonexempt portions of records that can reasonably be separated from exempt information.

This request is made pursuant to Chapter 119, Florida Statutes, including applicable provisions of §§112.533 and 119.07.

If any portion of these records is withheld, please identify the specific statutory exemption relied upon and provide the required written explanation.

I request electronic delivery of the responsive records. Please notify me in advance if estimated fees will exceed $25.

Thank you for your assistance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Roger Jaquez
